title: Series UX polish: delete-series, propagation toast, multi-day labels
description: Add a Delete-series button in the editor, an 'updated N instances' toast after a propagating save, and multi-day chip labels for clarity. Touches the editor popover and series propagation path in the planner.

title: Drag a block between weekdays in horizontal layout
description: Horizontal layout supports resize within a day but not lateral drag to move a block to a different weekday. Implement cross-day drag in the planner grid (src/routes/+page.svelte), persisting via the items API.

title: Drag-to-draw block creation on empty grid
description: Outlook-style click+drag on empty grid to size a new block before the editor opens; today a plain click creates a default 60-min block at click position. Lives in the planner UI (src/routes/+page.svelte); snap via snapMinute() at SNAP_MINUTES=5.

title: Alternating-week (A/B) template support
description: A sandbox models only one week; support biweekly patterns (e.g. events that alternate weeks). Likely a week_parity flag on items or a linked-sibling template pair. Schema + planner changes; design decision needed first.

title: Add keyboard shortcuts for planner actions
description: Wire shortcuts: n=new block, Esc=close editor, left/right=prev/next week, Cmd+S=save. Handle key events in the planner UI (src/routes/+page.svelte).

title: Settings: global default wake/sleep bounds for new templates/days
description: Add a global default wake/sleep bound applied to new templates and new days, separate from the existing per-day popover editor. Store in app_settings or template defaults; surface in the settings sidebar.

title: JSON import/export backup and restore for active version
description: JSON backup + restore for the active template version, optionally all sandboxes. Add a versions/items export and restore path (src/lib/server/db.ts + api/versions); replicate upsertItem clamping on bulk insert to avoid grid corruption.

title: Calendar export to .ics (Google/Outlook)
description: Push the template to Google/Outlook via .ics export. Serialize template items (integer-minute times) into iCalendar; new export endpoint/UI affordance.

title: Typography and spacing polish pass
description: Ongoing refinement of the calm visual direction: typography and spacing across the planner. Style-only, no schema changes.

title: Side-by-side schedule-version comparison view
description: Compare two saved schedule versions (templates) side by side. Read-only view rendering two template week views; no mutation path.
